rule.title: Without the election, general sales taxes stay off Schedule A line 5a

when_missing.because: Schedule A line 5a takes state and local income taxes unless the taxpayer elects general sales taxes; no election has been recorded.

citation.wording: If you don't elect to deduct general sales taxes, include on line 5a the state and local income taxes listed next.

rule.open_point: The optional sales tax table amount needs the table's income figure (a computation); only the client's own record of general sales taxes is a figure here.
